🔐 chore(docs): document GIT_CG_SKIP_PREPARE usage

Explains how to bypass `prepare-commit-msg` generation by setting `GIT_CG_SKIP_PREPARE` to `1`. This configuration streamlines message-only rebuilds and amends.
